SELECT DISTINCT
    "e"."name" AS "event_space_name",
    "e"."event_space" AS "event_space_type",
    "e"."capacity"
FROM
    "eventspaces" "e"
WHERE
    "e"."event_space" IN ('Banquet Hall', 'Conference Room')
    AND CAST("e"."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200
ORDER BY
    "e"."event_space", "e"."name";
2:
SELECT
    "name" AS event_space_name,
    "event_space" AS space_type,
    "capacity"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND TRIM("capacity") = '200';

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'Café' AND r."cuisine" = 'Italian'

UNION

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
ORDER BY
    "food_service", "name";

FROM "staff" s

  AND s."language" = 'English'

SELECT s1."id", s1."name", s1."role", s1."language"
FROM "staff" s1
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT s2."language"
    FROM "staff" s2
    WHERE s2."role" = 'Chef'
) chefs_lang ON s1."language" = chefs_lang."language"
WHERE s1."role" = 'Server';

WITH hospital_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid") AS total_hospitals
    FROM "hospitals"
),
role_hospital_count AS (
    SELECT
        "roleid",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid") AS hospitals_with_role
    FROM "hospitals_medical_roles"
    GROUP BY "roleid"
)
SELECT
    m."rolename",
    m."salary"::REAL AS salary
FROM "medicalroles" m
JOIN "role_hospital_count" rhc ON m."roleid" = rhc."roleid"
CROSS JOIN "hospital_count" hc
WHERE rhc."hospitals_with_role" = hc."total_hospitals";

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    STRING_AGG(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"::BIGINT
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id"::BIGINT = s."system_id"::BIGINT
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name"
ORDER BY
    its."id";
110:
SELECT
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"::BOOLEAN AS "is_active",
    its."name" AS "it_specialist_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
CROSS JOIN
    "systems" s
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON its."id" = iss."it_specialist_id" AND s."system_id" = iss."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
111:
SELECT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"::BOOLEAN AS is_active
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";

WITH internship_responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ir."responsibilityid",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "internships_responsibilities" ir
    GROUP BY
        ir."responsibilityid"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total
    FROM
        "internships"
)
SELECT
    r."responsibility"
FROM
    "responsibilities" r
JOIN
    internship_responsibility_counts irc ON r."id" = irc."responsibilityid"
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    irc.internship_count = ti.total;

SELECT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."id" AS responsibility_id,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility_name
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id";

    "systems" s ON iss."system_id"::BIGINT = s."system_id"::BIGINT

    sd."salary_range",

FROM
    "position" p

    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"

    LOWER("p"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer');

       j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
       j."jobtitle" AS position_title
